theorem lg_target (M : Type u_1) (R : Type u_2) [CommMonoid M] [CommRing R] [Finite M] [HasEnoughRootsOfUnity R (Monoid.exponent Mˣ)] : Nat.card (MulChar M R) = Nat.card Mˣ := by
  haveI : Fintype M := Finite.toFintype M
  haveI : HasEnoughRootsOfUnity R (Nat.card Mˣ) :=
    HasEnoughRootsOfUnity.ofNat (Nat.card Mˣ) R
  haveI : CommMonoidWithZero R := CommRing.toCommMonoidWithZero R
  let f := instFiniteMonoidHomUnitsOfHasEnoughRootsOfUnityExponent M R (CommMonoid.toCommGroup M) (CommRing.toCommMonoid R) (Finite.toFinite M) (HasEnoughRootsOfUnity.toHasEnoughRootsOfUnity R (Monoid.exponent Mˣ))
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := Nonempty.intro f
  let χ := MulChar.ofMonoidHom M R f
  haveI : Fintype (MulChar M R) := MulChar.fintype M R
  exact Nat.card_congr (MulChar.equiv M R f)
